_pipelinesNote: Pipeline names to include. Empty = every pipeline. firms/<slug>/discovery.json lists every pipeline and stage name.
_stagesNote: Stage names for each funnel step; must match GHL exactly (case does not matter). A later step counts as every earlier step, so list only the stages that first prove each step. Filled in by the admin page's mapping panel.
_turnedAwayNote: Why leads were turned away: a tag starting with tagPrefix (e.g. 'turned away: wrong practice area'), else the GHL lost reason, else the stage name if it's listed in stages.
_bookingNote: A consult = an appointment on a calendar whose name contains one of these words. Empty list = every calendar counts.
_adSpendNote: Monthly ad spend in dollars, by YYYY-MM. Spread evenly over the month's days for any date range. Used for cost per signed case.
